title: Field Guide
description: A Guide button on the start screen opens a page with every weapon, passive and bear: its icon, what it does, and what it evolves into.

title: Stop Loss
description: A new passive: when you drop under 25% HP, a stop-loss fires (at most once a minute) and blasts every bear near you away.

title: Short Squeeze
description: Once a run at 3:00, SHORT SQUEEZE flashes and every bear on screen turns and runs from you for 5 seconds, worth double XP if you chase them down.
